data.title: War Robots: Frontiers Anniversary
data.summary: One Year on the Wild Ten. Time to Celebrate!
data.meta_description: One Year on the Wild Ten. Time to Celebrate!
data.content:
War Robots: Frontiers has been forged in fire for a full year — and now it’s time to celebrate!

The Anniversary brings new content, rewards, the return of favorite Pilots, and a brand-new limited-time mode that will transform the battlefield. Whether you’ve fought through every conflict or are just stepping into the cockpit, this celebration is built for every pilot.

Buckle up!

Limited-Time Mode: Infinite Fuel (March 3 – March 17)

Unstable energy readings have been detected across the Wild Ten.

A rare atmospheric anomaly is disrupting standard fuel regulators, pushing reactor systems to sustained peak output without depletion. Engineers are monitoring the phenomenon, but combat operations continue as scheduled.

Until conditions stabilize, all War Robots are operating with effectively unlimited propulsion capacity.

Adapt — or fall behind.

Gameplay Changes

Infinite Fuel enters the Unranked rotation and reshapes combat across the Wild Ten. With fuel limits removed, pilots can:

  • Boost and dash without cooldown constraints
  • Maintain extended aerial control
  • Unlock new vertical routes and attack angles

This experimental limited-time mode is designed to reimagine mobility and pacing across existing maps and modes. Its return may depend on community feedback.

New Anniversary Pilot: Bruno Lantoni

Bruno Lantoni once ruled the racing circuits with millisecond precision. When age began to erode his edge, he refused to retire. Instead, he rebuilt himself — replacing much of his body with experimental cybernetics to remain competitive.

The athletic commission banned him for “excessive modification”.

Now he brings his engineered precision to robot warfare.

Bruno Lantoni will be obtainable during the limited-time Anniversary Vault event and will become available through additional methods at a later date.

Anniversary Vault (February 24 – March 11)

As reactor anomalies ripple across the Wild Ten and combat protocols shift, corporate archives are being temporarily reopened.

To mark one year of sustained conflict, sponsors and faction backers have authorized limited access to secured vault inventories — releasing select pilots, wraps, and archived assets back into circulation.

Among them is Bruno Lantoni, newly cleared for deployment in the Wild Ten.

Daily Rewards:

  • Day 1: 100 Intel, 10,000 Salvage, 3-Day Premium
  • Day 2: Molten Sands Wrap
  • Day 3: Emma James Pilot
  • Day 4: Emerald Blast Wrap
  • Day 5: “Dredge” Collins Pilot
  • Day 6: Raijin Strike Wrap
  • Day 7: Rex “Rope” Cole
  • Day 8: Burning Engines Wrap
  • Day 9: Anniversary Pilot, 15,000 Salvage
  • Day 10: Anniversary Decal, 15,000 Salvage

How to Participate:

  • Complete your Training Battles to qualify.
  • Play 5 battles and claim rewards as you go.
  • You must receive the previous reward to be eligible for the next one (you can’t skip rewards).

Missed something earlier? This is your chance to complete your collection.

Twitch Drops: Anniversary Payload (February 27 – March 10)

Celebrate with a full-scale delivery straight from the frontlines.

Watch War Robots: Frontiers on Twitch and earn heavy drops packed with robot parts and premium rewards.

Watch Time Rewards

  • 30 Minutes – 3-Day Premium Account
  • 1 Hour – Nanite Repair
  • 1 Hour 30 Minutes – Iron Veil
  • 2 Hours – x1 Bisector Weapon
  • 2 Hours 30 Minutes – x1 Halo Weapon
  • 3 Hours – Siren Chassis
  • 3 Hours 30 Minutes – x2 Mesa Shoulders
  • 4 Hours – Fenrir Torso

Load up. Suit up. Deploy stronger.

More to Celebrate

The Anniversary doesn’t end here.

Alongside the main events, we’ll be introducing a few extra activities, community rewards, and special offers throughout the celebration.

Stay locked in. Stay ready!
